nodes.name: Browser pane
nodes.responsibility: Where a user speaks: the tab makes the peer connection and carries the audio itself

nodes.name: Coordinator thread
nodes.responsibility: The separate fast thread voice attaches to, the voice model's subconscious: its model, its settings, and how it is started

nodes.name: Realtime voice
nodes.responsibility: The realtime leg of that thread: the offer, the answer, the channel rule, a narrated walkthrough's steps, and the transcript

nodes.name: Coordinator tools
nodes.responsibility: Runs the tool calls the coordinator makes, once each, against a replay ledger

nodes.name: Tool contract
nodes.responsibility: The frozen tool manifests and their digests: what the coordinator is allowed to ask for

nodes.name: Coordinator callbacks
nodes.responsibility: What the voice side is told while voice is live: workhorse news for the coordinator, pane news for the voice model

nodes.name: Spoken approval
nodes.responsibility: The gate that lets an approval be answered out loud, and the reasons it falls back to the pane

nodes.name: Approvals
nodes.responsibility: Every approval the child raises, answered exactly once whichever way the answer came

nodes.name: Semantic context
nodes.responsibility: What the board says right now and what the user changed on it: the brief a voice start records, and the reports that become pane news

nodes.name: Authored instructions
nodes.responsibility: The coordinator's own developer instructions, which neither contain nor refer to the workhorse's, pinned by digest

nodes.name: Codex transport
nodes.responsibility: Where a tool call or notification from the child arrives, routed to the owner registered for it

nodes.name: Codex session
nodes.responsibility: The reviewed methods the coordinator and its realtime leg are started on

nodes.name: Workhorse operations
nodes.responsibility: Where anything sustained goes: the four operations the coordinator may ask of the workhorse, one at a time

nodes.name: Callback queue
nodes.responsibility: Takes news, operation events and pane reports in order, drops the session's own writes, and delivers one at a time

nodes.name: Workhorse news
nodes.responsibility: A turn on the linked workhorse that ended or began waiting on the user, whoever started it, as one plain sentence

nodes.name: Tell coordinator
nodes.responsibility: Answers the workhorse's tell_coordinator call: its message becomes news, or it is told nobody is listening

nodes.name: Callback delivery
nodes.responsibility: Gives each callback one path: news to a coordinator turn, the user's own pane changes to the voice model, the rest recorded only

nodes.name: Outcome report
nodes.responsibility: Gives the coordinator one piece of news as one turn/start, joining its running turn or starting one, and nothing while a recording holds the voice
